sentences.quote: Elliott Hill will become President and Chief Executive Officer of NIKE, Inc., effective October 14, 2024. Hill will also become a Director of the NIKE, Inc. Board of Directors and a member of the Executive Committee.
sentences.text: Elliott Hill has been President and Chief Executive Officer of Nike, Inc. since October 14, 2024, succeeding John Donahoe and also joining the Nike board of directors and executive committee.

He was employed by Nike from 1988 to 2020 in senior leadership positions across Europe and North America, having been appointed VP Global Retail in 2006, VP/General Manager North America in 2010, President Geographies and Sales in 2013, and President Consumer and Marketplace in 2018, a role in which he led all commercial and marketing operations for Nike and Jordan Brand, including the profit and loss across the company's four geographies, before retiring in 2020.

sentences.quote: Hill is a graduate of Texas Christian University with a bachelor's degree in Kinesiology and Ohio University where he holds a master's degree in Sports Administration. He started his career as an assistant athletic trainer with the Dallas Cowboys
sentences.text: He holds a bachelor's degree in kinesiology from Texas Christian University and a master's in sports administration from Ohio University, and began his career as an assistant athletic trainer with the Dallas Cowboys.
